addins.name: Clarion Transformer
addins.description: Transforms Clarion code using Claude AI (Anthropic API). Takes the selected code block in the editor — or the active PROCEDURE if nothing is selected — and applies a user-defined protocol file (.md). Ships two fixed menu commands, each bound to its own profile: 'Transform to ABC' (legacy file I/O to ABC migration) and 'Refactor' (cleanup of existing ABC code). Supports per-profile Old/New code backups, optional explanatory comments, and configurable re-indentation. Sends the selected code and the protocol file to the Anthropic API using your own API key.
addins.author: asantarelli

addins.name: Clarion Formatter
addins.description: Reformats Clarion WINDOW blocks using Claude AI (Anthropic API). Formatting rules are configured per control type (coordinates, heights, widths, colors, tooltips, free-text rules) with a built-in Clarion Protocol v2.5 preset, and applied directly in the editor in two passes: format, then verify against the rules. Supports multiple profiles, one per project. Sends the active WINDOW block and the profile rules to the Anthropic API using your own API key; no other code leaves the machine.
addins.author: asantarelli
